name: Z -- Strokes, signs from hieratic, geometrical figures
_about: Gardiner's category Z, strokes, signs from hieratic, geometrical figures (glyphs.js): each sign in the quadrat (100 units, y up, the baseline at 0), facing left; `u` its Unicode code point, `reading` its sound value where it has one, `freq` how often texts use it (a wall of text draws by it), `colors` its roles in the painter's colours.

Z1.name: single stroke
Z1.reading: (the sign means what it shows; one)
